source: QLC+ fixture library (Laserworld/Laserworld-CS-1000RGB-Mk3.qxf), laser channels mapped by hand. The pattern numbers per shape are estimates: check them once on the real laser.

physical.light: 1 W RGB diode laser, ILDA + DMX

13ch._note: 000-127 angle, 128-191 CCW slow to fast, 192-255 CW slow to fast

laser._note: DMX value of 'Pattern Select' for each shape the show uses (the laser's pattern list decides: calibrate)
laser._note_sheet: a sheet is the fan pattern turned flat: Z rotation index (0-127) that lays the fan horizontal
laser._note_colors: multi = 'multi color step through' (225-255), rainbow = 'pattern color (original)' (0-24)

color_wheel._note: Laser colour macros (Color Change channel), from the QLC+ library.
